4 /-! Every convex dome unfolds by retaining its original base hinges. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
7 
8 namespace Face
9 
10 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron}
11 
12 /-- A third facet misses at least one of an original hinge's two endpoints. -/
13 theorem hinge_endpoints_with_one_outside (base F G : P.Face) (shared : P.ShareEdge base F)
14     (G_base : G ≠ base) (G_F : G ≠ F) :
15     ∃ a b : P.Vertex, a ≠ b ∧
16       (a : Space) ∈ base.val ∧ (b : Space) ∈ base.val ∧
17       (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (b : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (a : Space) ∉ G.val := by
18   obtain ⟨a, av, b, bv, ab, edge⟩ := base.shared_edge_endpoints F shared
19   have a_common : a ∈ base.val ∩ F.val := by rw [edge]; exact left_mem_segment ℝ a b
20   have b_common : b ∈ base.val ∩ F.val := by rw [edge]; exact right_mem_segment ℝ a b
21   by_cases aG : a ∈ G.val
22   · have bG : b ∉ G.val := by
23       intro member
24       have contains : base.val ∩ F.val ⊆ G.val := by
25         rw [edge]
26         exact G.convex.segment_subset aG member
27       exact (base.facets_containing_shared_edge F shared G contains).elim G_base G_F
28     exact ⟨⟨b, bv⟩, ⟨a, av⟩, (fun same => ab (congrArg Subtype.val same).symm),
29       b_common.1, a_common.1, b_common.2, a_common.2, bG⟩
30   · exact ⟨⟨a, av⟩, ⟨b, bv⟩, (fun same => ab (congrArg Subtype.val same)),
31       a_common.1, b_common.1, a_common.2, b_common.2, aG⟩
32 
33 end Face
34 
35 namespace Dome
36 
37 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {dome : P.Dome}
38 
39 /-- Every pair of distinct outward petals has disjoint interior, with no bound on the number of vertices. -/
40 theorem Development.petals_nonoverlap (net : dome.Development) (F G : P.Face)
41     (F_side : F ≠ dome.base) (G_side : G ≠ dome.base) (different : F ≠ G) :
42     Disjoint (interior (net.place F '' F.val)) (interior (net.place G '' G.val)) := by
43   obtain ⟨center, inside⟩ := P.solid
44   obtain ⟨facets⟩ := P.exists_normalized_facets inside
45   obtain ⟨a, b, ab, aB, bB, aF, bF, aG⟩ := dome.base.hinge_endpoints_with_one_outside F G
46     (dome.side_shares_base F F_side) G_side different.symm
47   obtain ⟨c, d, cd, cB, dB, cG, dG, cF⟩ := dome.base.hinge_endpoints_with_one_outside G F
48     (dome.side_shares_base G G_side) F_side different
49   exact net.opposite_petals_nonoverlap facets F G F_side G_side a b c d ab cd
50     aB bB cB dB aF bF cG dG aG cF
51 
52 /-- The whole-face flower of any convex dome is an original-edge unfolding. -/
53 theorem hasEdgeUnfolding (dome : P.Dome) : P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
54   obtain ⟨net⟩ := dome.exists_development
55   exact Development.hasEdgeUnfolding dome net (fun F G hF hG hFG =>
56     Development.petals_nonoverlap net F G hF hG hFG)
57 
58 end Dome
59 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
